name: Erwin Custom Fabrication
old_description: For over 28 years, Erwin Custom Fabrication has specialized in custom welding and metalwork in Nampa and across Idaho—precision-built for your needs.
about:
Erwin Custom Fabrication operates from a shop at 811 North Kings Road in Nampa, Idaho, serving the Treasure Valley since its founding in 1993. The company began as a custom welding and metalwork operation and has grown into a full-service fabrication facility over more than three decades.

The shop provides structural steel fabrication, custom welding, sheet metal work, aluminum and stainless steel fabrication, and laser cutting. It produces a range of items including range hoods, gates and fences, metal cabinets, countertops, signs, sinks, wainscoting, stair and railing systems, and steel tanks for industrial use. All cutting, forming, and welding is performed in-house on steel, aluminum, stainless, copper, and sheet metal.

Customers include residential homeowners, builders, commercial contractors, and industrial clients across Nampa, Caldwell, Meridian, Eagle, Star, Boise, Garden City, Kuna, McCall, Cascade, and Emmett. Projects span architectural metalwork, foodservice equipment, and structural frameworks.

The company emphasizes shop capacity over sales rhetoric, highlighting its 32-plus years of experience, a 5.0 rating from over 140 local reviews, and a focus on accurate fits, clean finishes, and dependable communication.
